meta.title: Mascote — Take care of you. They grow with you.
meta.description: Brazilian-born companion that grows when you sleep, drink water, breathe. 4 AI personalities, forgiving streaks, local-first. No leaderboards, no guilt.
meta.ogAlt: Mascote — wellness with a Brazilian soul

hero.sub: Mascote is a Brazilian-born digital companion that grows when you sleep, drink water, breathe. Four AI personalities, a streak that forgives, and everything kept on your device.
hero.ctaSecondaryNote: No card. No charge during beta.
hero.ticker: Take care of you · They grow with you · No streak shaming · No guilt · Just presence ·

trust.headline: We believe taking care of yourself shouldn't feel like a checklist.
trust.body: It should be small. Daily. Light. And there should be something on the other side, waiting. So we built a companion that listens, evolves, and doesn't shame you when the day was hard.

personalities.headline: Which one will walk with you?
personalities.sub: Each personality speaks differently. Real AI tuned to care — not to flatter, not to play therapist.

items.name: Bipo
items.quote: I'm here with you. No hurry.

items.name: Lulu
items.quote: Good to see you. Tell me.

evolution.headline: Six stages. A bond that grows with you.
evolution.sub: Egg, baby, child, teen, adult, ascended. Each check-in hatches a little more of them. No death. No emotional blackmail.

features.headline: Built so you come back lighter.

items.title: AI chat with four voices
items.body: GPT-4o-mini with prompts hand-tuned in real Brazilian Portuguese. No 'self-care journey'. No translated clichés.

items.title: A streak that forgives
items.body: Missed a day? No guilt. Use a freeze or come back tomorrow. We don't hold a flame over your head.

items.title: Daily wheel of luck
items.body: Eight slices, one spin a day. A surprise that fits — not a casino loop.

items.title: 17 accessories, 6 scenes
items.body: Cap, glasses, scarf, library, moon, café. Dress your mascot your way.

items.title: Theme × palette, your way
items.body: Light, sepia or dark — five orange palettes. Match how today feels.

items.title: Crisis response, taken seriously
items.body: Across all four personalities: local hotlines, emergency lines, no improvising. We don't play with this.

items.title: Local-first with BYOK
items.body: Your data stays on your device. Bring your OpenAI key if you want more — or use Plus.

items.title: No leaderboard, no compare
items.body: No 'you're better than 78% of users'. You take care of you. That's it.

showcase.headline: Small every day. Sticky every month.

items.title: Check-in in 4 taps
items.body: Mood, water, sleep, kindness. Thirty seconds. Done.

items.title: Daily surprise box
items.body: One a day. Five random drops. Confetti when it lands well.

items.title: Human weekly report
items.body: No toxic charts. A short sentence, a picture of your mascot, and what shifted in you.

pricing.headline: Seven days free. Then you decide.
pricing.sub: No sneaky auto-renewal. Cancel in one tap, in your store settings. Seriously.

plans.name: Bipo Plus
plans.tagline: For going all the way with your mascot.
features: Unlimited AI chat across all 4 personalities

pricing.legal: The 7-day trial asks for a card to reduce fraud. Cancel anytime in one tap. We never sell data. Ever.

items.a: No. Mascote is wellness and self-care, not clinical. When you need a professional, we point you there — local hotlines and emergency numbers are visible across every personality, always.

items.q: What if I miss a day?
items.a: Your mascot doesn't die. It waits. You can buy a streak freeze with coins, or just come back tomorrow. We don't use fire emojis to guilt you.
On your device. Local-first storage. For AI chat, bring your own OpenAI key (BYOK) or use Plus. We never sell, rent, or share. Period.
Closed beta on both. The native Android APK is already running (144 MB). iOS lands together for soft launch. Join the list for early access.
One tap, straight in your App Store or Google Play settings. No five screens, no 'wait a little more', no retention pressure. Promise.
16 and up. We confirm at entry and block if you're younger. Responsibility choice, not market choice.
No. The mascot doesn't say 'I love you' or 'you're my only one'. It says 'I'm here'. When users show excessive attachment, the AI encourages human connection. Healthy bond, never replacement.
The whole app works offline: check-ins, habits, customization, rewards. Only the AI chat needs the internet (and your key or plan).

quotes.text: Finally a wellness app that sounds Brazilian. No more translated 'self-care journey' clichés.
quotes.author: Carolina, 28

quotes.text: I missed 3 days in a row and the mascot just said 'I'm here'. Didn't make me feel guilty. First time.
quotes.author: Rafael, 34

quotes.text: Bipo, Zip, Lulu and Aro feel like characters, not bots. You feel the difference in two messages.
quotes.author: Mariana, 25

newsletter.headline: Read first, decide later.
newsletter.sub: One letter a month with behind-the-scenes, lines from your mascot, and a self-care prompt. No upsell.
newsletter.success: I'm here. Next letter comes soon.
newsletter.legal: No spam. Unsubscribe in one click from any email footer.

lines: We believe taking care of yourself shouldn't be a checklist.
It should be small. Daily. Light.
There should be something on the other side, waiting for you.
You sleep well. They gain energy.
You drink water. They get happy.
You stay silent for a minute. Their world slows down.
But if you fail, they don't die. They wait.
Because real life works like that — and so does care.
manifesto.signoff: Mascote. Take care of you. They grow with you.

footer.tagline: Wellness with a Brazilian soul. Built slowly in São Paulo.
footer.safetyNote: If you're in crisis, please reach out to a local hotline. In the US: 988. In the UK: 116 123. In Brazil: 188.
